title: hk engine: inventory, classify, plan, apply, journal, undo (stdlib Python 3.9+)
description: The shared deterministic engine every skill drives. Collectors for git, files, runtime, harness, caches; classification by safety class, provenance, and protection; a reviewed plan applied exactly (terraform plan -out style) with per-item precondition re-check, a journal, and undo recipes.

acceptanceCriteria.text: hk inventory/plan/apply/undo/ledger/doctor subcommands exist and emit the {schemaVersion, kind, data} JSON envelope with semantic exit codes
apply refuses any item whose target changed since planning, and never executes S3 items without an explicit per-item confirmation id

branch classification never marks a branch with unique unlanded commits as removable, proven by a unit test with squash-merged, merged, unlanded, gone-but-unmerged, retain/, and worktree-checked-out branches
file removal moves to trash by default, refuses paths outside the declared root, and never touches .env* or tracked files, proven by unit tests

implementationNotes: Evidence: tests/test_hk.py + tests/test_capture_hook.py, 22 passed on Python 3.9.6 (.venv). AC2: test_branch_that_moved_after_planning_is_skipped, test_file_changed_after_plan_is_skipped, test_stale_unlanded_branch_is_s3_and_archived_before_delete. AC3: test_branch_classification_never_plans_unlanded_work (merged, squashed, unlanded, gone, retain/, worktree). AC4: test_apply_trashes_files_and_refuses_protected_and_outside_paths (this test caught a real bug: $TMPDIR was a global allowed root; roots are now scoped per item kind). Eval iteration 1 found 3 more defects, fixed in 6c93b21: state leaked into <repo>/.claude (now .git/housekeeping), worktree-held landed branch needed two passes, claude project purge no-op on slug mismatch.
